description: This file implements an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with support for TTL (time-to-live), size calculations, background fetches, and deprecation warnings. It defines classes for managing cache entries, size tracking, and abort controllers for fetch operations.

classes.name: AbortSignal
classes.description: Implements an abort signal for cancelling fetch operations, with polyfill support for environments lacking native support.

classes.name: AbortController
classes.description: Controls the abort signal, allowing fetch operations to be cancelled.

classes.name: ZeroArray
classes.description: A subclass of Array filled with zeros, used for TTL and size tracking.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: A simple stack implementation for managing free indices in the cache.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: Main class implementing a configurable least recently used cache with features like TTL, size constraints, and background fetch handling.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry, optionally with TTL, size, and status tracking.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry, considering staleness and background fetches.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries and resets internal state.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a value asynchronously, with support for background fetches and TTL management.

methods.name: backgroundFetch
methods.description: Starts a background fetch operation for a key.

methods.name: isBackgroundFetch
methods.description: Checks whether a value is a background fetch promise.
